ranking.okr_rule: use the highest alignment_points among active referenced OKRs; unknown and archived OKRs score zero
tie_breakers: earliest due date with missing last

blocking: An item is blocked when any blocker_key refers to a non-terminal work item.

routing.decision: select the unique highest-scoring enabled repo; zero-score and top-score ties require review

execution.eligible: non-terminal, not blocked, every contributing author is known and trusted, and routing has one enabled winner
execution.selection: scan ranked inbox in order and take the first eligible items
execution.review: flag every non-terminal item that is blocked, has an unknown or untrusted contributing author, or has ambiguous/missing routing

context.match: within the routed repo, score each symbol by distinct whole-word overlaps between ticket text and context keywords
tie_breakers: blast radius high then medium then low
